sources.title: mms-tts: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview mms-tts is a massively multilingual text-to-speech model developed by facebook that synthesizes speech in over 1,000 languages from text input. This model is part of Facebook's Massively Multilingual Speech project, which aims to provide speech technology across a diverse range of languages documented in ISO 639-3 codes.
